_notes: Four placeholder straight conveyor belts spanning narrow short-run through wide long-run. Vendor data is intentionally generic — no specific catalog was traced. Replace with real datasheets (Interroll, Dorner, FlexLink) before any engineering decision relies on these numbers.
belt_width_m is the cross-belt width; the placed belt's footprint is a rectangle this wide along the routed length.

min_length_m / max_length_m bound the straight-line length the model can be built to. Belt routing (step-6 M2) selects the cheapest belt whose range covers the resolved source -> sink distance; ranges overlap on purpose so the selection has choices.
max_speed_m_s and prices are rough engineering estimates so the routing/cost code has comparable numbers; refine before use.
